announcements.title: Barangay Public Assistance & Service Desk Hours
announcements.body: The Barangay Hall is open Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM for document clearances, barangay certifications, and citizen assistance.

announcements.title: Disaster Preparedness & 24/7 Emergency Hotlines
announcements.body: For urgent medical assistance, emergency response, or fire dispatch, please dial 117 / 911 or contact the Barangay Emergency Operations Desk.
